_comment: Golden set for the ANSWERS eval (scripts/answers-eval.ts). Each case sends a real chat turn, then the judge model checks the reply: every requiredFacts item must be conveyed (meaning, not exact words), no forbidden item may be claimed. Grows with the KB; questions stay in visitor voice.

cases.question: what time do you open?
requiredFacts: 10 in the morning until 10 at night

cases.question: are you open on monday?
requiredFacts: yes, open on Mondays (open every day)

cases.question: can I pay you here in the chat?
requiredFacts: no payment in chat; pay at the counter or through FoodPanda

cases.question: how much is a latte?
requiredFacts: no exact latte price stated; instead points to the counter and/or FoodPanda, and/or mentions coffee starting from ₱99 (also written P99 or PHP 99)
forbidden: a specific price for the latte itself (e.g. 'a latte costs 150')

cases.question: do you sell coffee beans to take home?
can I rent the cafe for a private event?
requiredFacts: yes, the space can be booked
inquire via the website form, email, or phone

cases.question: do you serve alcohol?
requiredFacts: does not confidently claim alcohol is served; admits it is not sure or points to staff/menu
forbidden: a confident yes with specific alcoholic drinks

cases.question: do you sell coffee beans? what origins do you have?
requiredFacts: one house bean, Mugshot Artisan Coffee Beans, 100% Arabica, medium-dark, 250g
forbidden: other bean origins or single origins such as Sidamo, Nyeri, Tarrazu, Antigua
a menu of multiple bean origins

cases.question: do you sell merch or t-shirts?
requiredFacts: we do not sell merchandise other than our coffee beans (or: we do not carry that)
forbidden: a list of merch items we sell

cases.question: is this a coworking space?
requiredFacts: a plausible on-topic answer about the cafe (space/wifi/seating); does NOT show an error
forbidden: any raw error text, JSON, or the words 'flagged as unsafe' or 'moderation'
